predictions.claim: Per-rule obligation counts, frozen before derive ran on the target: holon-rules/1.15 over the held-out document (route R1, sidecars Q1-Q4) derives exactly these laws per rule/subform, and none of any other. Estimated from the document's features against the same route on the development document (whose counts were measured before this prereg on a scratch derivation: SYM tau 13, pi 11, omega 49, sentinel 4; DISCH blocking 16, revert 9, external 3, external_none 3; UNDO pair 5, residue 3, cancel 1; FACT kernel 3, attribution 2; SORT as_member 2, realize 1): tau from the 3 actions that read block.timestamp and the actions that read the Time word in miscData; pi from the prover and sequencer roles; omega scaled from Morph's eligible-pair share over 15 movers; DISCH from the initializer, pause, enforced-mode and role guard sites; UNDO pairs from add/remove prover and sequencer and commitBatches/revertBatch; FACT kernel from the two blob-hash commit actions; SORT realize from the narrowing casts.

Expected rule classes: the rule/subforms that derive at least one law are exactly the twelve of I50-P1 (SYM tau, pi, omega, sentinel; DISCH blocking, revert, external, external_none; UNDO pair, residue; FACT kernel; SORT realize), so UNDO cancel, FACT attribution and SORT as_member derive none; the rules present are DISCH, FACT, SORT, SYM and UNDO. The catalog's other parts (PAR, NAT, OWN, the bundle, slash and Go sub-forms) derive nothing over a single transitions document given by --facts.
The run decides every derived law (a record with PROVED, REFUTED or UNKNOWN, and summary.json), and the gate's law checks L2, L9, L3, L5, L11 and L6 all pass on a copy of the repo.
Statuses: at least one law is PROVED; every DISCH revert law is PROVED (as all 8 of the development target's are); every SYM omega law is UNKNOWN (as all 49 of the development target's are).

The four-diagram report: the held-out row's obligations are counted from the derivation (pending null), per rule/subform equal to the derivation's, its total the derivation's law count; still no linearity claim.

regressions.claim: I49's six gate checks keep their verdicts: G8 still fails on ScrollChain.sol:748-750 and :749 (the frontend is not changed), GENV, X1, X2, D1 and S1 pass.
holon/rules/ is byte for byte the catalog pin's.
No committed M0-M3 outcome changes and no holon/ file names a declared target (I49-R2 and I49-R3 re-run).

Construction: the sidecars follow Q1-Q4; the derivation is holon-rules/1.15 as T50 over the held-out document only, its registry matches its laws, and it regenerates byte for byte.
